# helsinki - Helsinki open data R tools

The goal of helsinki package is to provide tools in R to access and
download open data from City of Helsinki and the Helsinki metropolitan
area - the Finnish capital region.

## Installation

You can install the released version of helsinki from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r

install.packages("helsinki")
```

And the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes)
library(remotes)
remotes::install_github("ropengov/helsinki")
```

## Using the package

Loading the package:

``` r

library(helsinki)
```

List available features from Helsinki Region Environmental Services HSY
WFS API and then download the 15th feature from that list:

``` r

url <- "https://kartta.hsy.fi/geoserver/wfs"
hsy_features <- get_feature_list(base.url = url)
get_feature(base.url = url, typename = hsy_features$Name[15])
```

For more examples, check the [tutorial
page](http://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/articles/helsinki_tutorial.md).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`get_city_map()`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/get_city_map.md)
  : Get city administrative regions
- [`get_feature()`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/get_feature.md)
  : Produce an SF object
- [`get_feature_list()`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/get_feature_list.md)
  : Print all available Features
- [`get_hri_stats()`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/get_hri_stats.md)
  : Helsinki Region Infoshare statistics API
- [`get_linkedevents()`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/get_linkedevents.md)
  : Access Helsinki Linked Events API
- [`get_rakennustietoruudukko()`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/get_rakennustietoruudukko.md)
  : Produce an SF object: Rakennustietoruudukko
- [`get_servicemap()`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/get_servicemap.md)
  : Access Helsinki region Service Map API
- [`get_vaestotietoruudukko()`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/get_vaestotietoruudukko.md)
  : Produce an SF object: Vaestotietoruudukko
- [`helsinki-package`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/helsinki-package.md)
  [`helsinki`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/helsinki-package.md)
  : Helsinki open data R tools
- [`select_feature()`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/select_feature.md)
  : Interactively browse and select features
- [`to_sf()`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/to_sf.md) :
  Transform to sf-object
- [`wfs_api()`](https://ropengov.github.io/helsinki/reference/wfs_api.md)
  : WFS API
